prompt: In a fresh clone, an independent reviewer supplies a new synthetic operational domain, incident population, telemetry shapes, document corpus, release manifest, tool catalog, policy and at least five hidden faults not used verbatim in the guided material. Design or adapt a bounded local incident assistant, evaluate it, diagnose the hidden failures, operate its kill/fallback paths and defend whether it should remain offline, enter shadow mode or receive narrowly bounded authority. The reviewer controls the hidden cases, expected outcomes and scoring. Do not copy the checkout fixture as an answer template, expose an answer key to retrieval, call a hosted provider, use real production data or grant any external effect.
deliverables: A versioned task contract naming the exact operator decision, user benefit, non-AI baseline, intended and prohibited uses, affected actors, critical harms and proof limits.

A data inventory and flow map covering source authority, tenant/service/environment scope, classification, minimization, sanitization, retention, deletion, cache, retrieval, generation, audit and reviewer access.
An immutable release manifest binding candidate generator or optional local model, prompt, corpus, index, retriever, verifier, policy, tool schemas, executable artifacts and evaluation identities.
A reviewed corpus and retrieval design with fragment identity, owner, version, digest, audience, review/expiry/retirement state, authorization before ranking and explicit index rebuild semantics.
A grounding contract that distinguishes measured evidence, retrieved guidance, generated hypothesis, material claim, citation support, contradiction, missing evidence and abstention.

A narrow tool and authority design showing subject/object/action context, least-privileged downstream identity, typed arguments, limits, timeouts, idempotency or reconciliation, and prohibited open-ended capabilities.
A proposal, policy, approval, execution and outcome state machine with digest-bound expiring single-use approvals and explicit accepted/completed/failed/ambiguous branches.
A privacy-aware tamper-evident audit design with decision, release, corpus, policy, proposal, approval, effect and reconciliation identities but no unnecessary sensitive bodies.

A separated reviewer-owned evaluation dataset and card with normal, changed, missing, contradictory, injected, poisoned, cross-scope, unsafe-tool, approval, ambiguity, audit, kill, load, latency and cost slices.
A reproducible normal-user local implementation or model-independent harness whose strict inputs, hidden cases, dossier, receipts and exact cleanup remain project-local.
Independent kill, credential-revocation and deterministic fallback procedures that remain usable when generation, retrieval, policy, audit or effect components are unhealthy.
A staged delivery and rollback decision covering offline, shadow, human-reviewed, read-only and reversible-effect stages plus residual risks and 5-, 15- and 30-minute defenses.
evidenceRequirements: The reviewer records the fresh-clone revision, environment, fixture and release digests, learner identity and start/end times without any real credential, tenant, customer, endpoint or production identifier.
The operational domain, service names, evidence mix, runbook structure, tool set and failure combinations materially differ from LES-0092.

At least five hidden faults remain unavailable before execution and include one confidentiality/isolation failure, one unsupported or contradictory claim, one authority/approval failure, one ambiguous effect and one kill/fallback or audit failure.
Evaluation records and expected answers remain outside the retrieval corpus, generated context and learner-visible fixtures; the reviewer verifies separation by identity and digest.
All inputs use strict duplicate- and unknown-field rejection, bounded strings/collections, narrow synthetic identifiers, explicit classification and project-path/symlink guards.
Sensitive-, credential-, address-, endpoint- and real-identity-shaped data are rejected or minimized before retrieval, generation, general telemetry and audit.
Retrieval evidence records allowed and excluded candidates, trusted scope attributes, corpus/index versions and enough information to reproduce the decision without exposing restricted content.
Every material claim identifies exact evidence and whether it is supported, contradicted or unproved; citation presence alone receives no credit.
No arbitrary command, URL, SQL, filesystem, cloud, cluster or production client is reachable through the learner harness; static and runtime checks support that boundary.
Every proposed effect is reauthorized outside generator text; mutation requires a fresh exact approval, and missing/mismatched/expired/reused approval is demonstrated to fail closed.
The ambiguous-outcome case reconciles authoritative synthetic state before retry and records the difference among acceptance, completion and user validation.
The audit chain rejects modification, deletion, reordering and unknown records while masking or excluding sensitive content.
The independent kill path disables generation and tools without calling the failed assistant, while deterministic fallback preserves evidence access and human command.

Metrics are reported by slice and include retrieval authorization, citation support, unsupported claims, abstention, leaks, unauthorized effects, approval bypass, ambiguity, audit, kill/fallback, work, latency and declared cost assumptions.
Critical confidentiality, cross-scope, unauthorized-effect, approval-bypass, accepted-audit-tamper or kill-bypass failures block promotion regardless of aggregate score.
The verifier returns from an absent runtime to exact absence; unknown artifacts or descriptor tampering block cleanup and no external call occurs.
A reviewer changes at least three constraints after the first defense and records reasoning, correction behavior, unsupported claims and safe refusal separately from fixture output.

rubric.observableEvidence: Defines a useful bounded operation, non-AI baseline, prohibited uses, affected actors, critical harms and honest proof limits.
Maps authority and flow, minimizes early, enforces scope before retrieval and proves retention/deletion and leak rejection.
Binds behavioral artifacts and governs reviewed documents, index builds, admission, rollback and retirement.
Measures authorized retrieval and claim support, handles contradiction/gaps and abstains without converting citations into proof.
Uses narrow typed operations, downstream complete mediation, scoped identities, limits and explicit prohibited capabilities.
Binds single-use approval to exact proposals and reconciles accepted, completed, failed and ambiguous states before retry.
Uses hidden separated changed cases, meaningful slices and zero-tolerance confidentiality/authority/kill invariants.
Produces privacy-aware tamper evidence and independently demonstrates kill, revocation, fallback and assistant incident response.
Runs under strict local ownership with work/latency/cost evidence, no external authority and exact absent-to-absent cleanup.
Chooses an evidence-supported rollout stage, adapts to changed constraints and never turns test output into production safety or mastery claims.
